ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE DISCLOSURE Please note that SEIU Healthcare may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position. Over time, this structure will allow employees to become beneficiaries of the future financial success of KCI. All inquiries and applications will be held in strict confidence. Interested candidates should send their resume and letter of interest to Julie Donovan, Manager, Search + Talent Operations at: ProjectCoordinator@kcitalent.com . Please note that we will be reviewing candidates on an ongoing basis, early submission is appreciated. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Artificial intelligence will not be used to screen resumes or assess candidates in this search. KCI is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and accessible work environment. KCI will, upon the request of the applicant, provide accommodation during the recruitment process to ensure equal access to applicants with disabilities. If you are selected for an interview and you require accommodation, please inform us. ABOUT KCI The nature of the Canadian charitable sector has changed ? irreversibly. New ideas, new models, new technologies, new generations and new Canadians present opportunities and challenges for Canadian charities. Where do we go from here? At KCI, that?s our favourite question . title: HR & Office Administrator
description: About Rainbow Railroad Rainbow Railroad is an international nonprofit that helps at-risk LGBTQI+ get to safety. Our mission is to provide life-saving support for LGBTQI+ people experiencing discrimination, violence, and persecution based on their sexual orientation, gender identity, or sex characteristics (SOGIESC). We work at the intersection of LGBTQI+ identities and forced displacement as advocates, thought leaders, movement strategists, community organizers, and direct service providers. Since our founding in 2006, we have supported close to 40,000 at-risk LGBTQI+ people globally, built sustainable partnerships with hundreds of organizations and coalitions, and publicly engaged millions of people about the forced displacement crisis affecting the LGBTQI+ community. Rainbow Railroad is a registered charity in Canada and a 501(c)3 organization in the United States. About the Position Rainbow Railroad is seeking a highly organized, reliable, and detail-oriented HR & Office Administrator to keep our Toronto office running smoothly and to support a positive, engaged, and well-functioning workplace. This role is perfect for someone who takes pride in creating order and supporting others. Whether you?re an emerging HR professional eager to learn and grow, or an experienced administrator who values discretion, confidentiality, and efficiency, you?ll be the friendly face that keeps our office organized, our systems running, and our people connected. Working closely with the Operations and HR teams, you will handle day-to-day office management, coordinate logistics, support HR administration, and contribute to building staff morale and engagement. This is an on-site role at our downtown Toronto office. Key Responsibilities Office Administration Assist in managing day-to-day operations of Rainbow Railroad?s Toronto office, ensuring a welcoming, well-organized, and efficient environment Serve as the first point of contact for staff, visitors, and external inquiries (including monitoring our hire@ inbox), responding promptly and professionally Maintain office supplies, systems, and equipment; liaise with vendors for maintenance, custodial, and catering Coordinate staff gatherings, celebrations, and team-building moments that foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Track and process invoices, expenses, and purchase orders in accordance with established financial procedures. Maintain the HR and Administrative procedurals. Helping to refine internal office and HR systems and policies for efficiency and clarity. Provide administrative support to the Director, HR and Admin, the COO, and CEO as needed. Human Resources Administration Serve as the primary contact for general HR-related inquiries, maintaining confidentiality and discretion at all times. Support recruitment processes by scheduling interviews, preparing onboarding materials, and coordinating new hire orientation. Maintain and update HR records, contracts, and staff files with accuracy and attention to detail. Support the administration of benefits, leaves, and performance review cycles. Help organize staff training, engagement initiatives, and recognition activities to strengthen morale and organizational culture. Ensure HR and office policies are followed consistently and communicated clearly across the organization. Qualifications & Attributes Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field or equivalent experience in office administration. 1-3 years of relevant experience preferred, ideally in a non-profit or mission-driven environment. Exceptional organizational and time management skills; able to manage multiple priorities calmly and effectively. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a professional, approachable demeanor. Proven ability to handle sensitive information with tact, discretion, and confidentiality. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and HR information systems (experience with CollageHR or similar is an asset). A team player who brings enthusiasm, initiative, and a solutions-oriented attitude to everyday tasks. Commitment to the mission and values of Rainbow Railroad and to fostering an inclusive, supportive workplace. Application Deadline ? accepting applications on a rolling basis Length of Contract ? Full-Time, 1 year contract with the possibility of extension Location - Toronto, ON. Work Style - 4 days in office/ 1 day wfh Hiring Salary ? $60,000 plus benefits Application Process - Please submit your application through the portal link Rainbow Railroad is dedicated to building an organization that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. This includes diversity in languages spoken, culture, race, sexual orientation, and gender identity. Requests for accommodation due to disability can be made at any stage in the recruitment process. Please email hire@rainbowrailroad.org for inquiries. We thank all applicants for their interest in this position, however we will only be contacting those selected for next steps. 1 - 2 years of experience
